# inFIT24

> inFIT24 (also called inFIT 24 and inFIT 24/7) is a 24/7 gym in Albertville, Minnesota. It is open every day of the year, including holidays. Memberships are month-to-month with no contracts, start at $60/month, and include infrared sauna access. The gym is at 6589 Laketowne Place NE, Albertville, MN 55301, just off I-94 near the Albertville Premium Outlets and Costco. Free on-site parking is available. There is no childcare and no tanning.

Members unlock the facility through the gym's mobile app. The app is called "inFIT247" in the App Store and Google Play; the gym brand is "inFIT24." The gym is open 24/7/365. Staffed hours are Monday–Friday 9:00 am–1:00 pm, Monday–Thursday 3:00 pm–7:00 pm, Saturday 8:00 am–12:00 pm, and Sunday by appointment. Call or text 763-424-4435 or email info@infit.org.

Members must be 13 or older to use the gym. Members under 16 have limited access and must work out during staffed hours or with a family member who is also a member (there is a separate check-in procedure). Youth fitness programming is available at select times; the gym asks people to contact them about children under 13.

## Memberships & Pricing

- [Memberships](https://infit.org/memberships): Current plans — Gym $60/mo; Dual $110/mo (2 household members); Family $155/mo (3–5 household members); Plus $84/mo (4 group classes/month); Premium $104/mo (unlimited group classes); Ultimate $204/mo (unlimited group classes + unlimited group training). All plans include 24/7 gym access, infrared sauna, and an equipment orientation. Member add-on rates: group exercise classes $12/session, group training $20/session. Day pass $10; week pass $25; month pass $74. Single drop-in group exercise class $15; single drop-in group training session $25. 5-pack group training = $115; 5-pack group exercise = $65. Military, first responders, and nurses receive 10% off all membership tiers. Insurance and wellness partners: SilverSneakers, Renew Active, One Pass, Prime Fitness Your Way, Husk, Active & Fit Standard, and Active & Fit Premium (eligibility depends on the member's plan).
- [FAQ — membership details](https://infit.org/faq): There is a $50 enrollment fee when you join, plus a $50 annual enhancement fee. Cancel anytime in the inFIT24 app — no notice required, no cancellation fees. Membership holds are available for up to 3 months (or longer in certain circumstances) for a $10/month hold fee. A $10 7-day trial includes 24/7 gym access, 1 sauna session, 1 group exercise class, and 1 group training session. Guests sign in at the front desk and pay a $10 guest pass fee. The Gym membership also includes unlimited sauna sessions, a 20-minute equipment orientation with a personal trainer, one group exercise class, and one group training session to try. The Ultimate membership includes unlimited group classes and unlimited group training; personal training is a separate add-on and is not included. The 10% Hero discount applies to military, police, and medical professionals. Short-term student memberships are available for students home during breaks and summer. No standard student or senior discounts. No childcare. No tanning. Free on-site parking.
- [Find your membership quiz](https://infit.org/find-your-fit): A 60-second, four-question quiz that recommends a plan; no email required.

## Amenities

- [Amenities](https://infit.org/amenities): 24/7 secure app access; Sunlighten infrared sauna; cardio, plate-loaded, and selectorized equipment; free weights and barbells; power racks and benches; functional turf; TRX and battle ropes; kettlebells and medicine balls; weighted sleds; plyometric boxes; spin bikes; boxing bags; rowing machines; stair climbers; treadmills, recumbent bikes, and ellipticals; BOSU balls; a group exercise studio and a spin studio; private bathrooms and showers; HDTVs; community space and refreshments; community challenges; on-site physical therapy (Elevate Physical Therapy, with Beth named on the FAQ); and the inFIT24 mobile app. No tanning. No childcare. Free on-site parking.
- [Infrared sauna](https://infit.org/amenities#sauna): Complimentary infrared sauna access is included with all memberships. Private 30- or 60-minute sessions are reserved in the app. Towels are provided for sauna use; members should bring their own towel for showering or general gym use.

## FAQ

- [Frequently asked questions](https://infit.org/faq): About 40 visible questions covering membership and pricing, the $10 7-day trial, discounts and insurance, 24/7 access and staffed hours, sauna booking, classes and group training, personal training, location, beginner support, on-site physical therapy, age requirements, towels, parking, childcare, and tanning. Key policies: cancel anytime (no notice, no fees); free on-site parking; no childcare; no tanning; $50 enrollment fee; $50 annual enhancement fee; membership holds $10/month. Group exercise classes mentioned include Spin, Boxing, Cardio Circuit, Group Strength, Butts & Guts, and Kettlebell. Non-members can drop in for group exercise at $15/session or group training at $25/session; 5-pack group exercise = $65, 5-pack group training = $115. Select classes are livestreamed on Zoom; livestream classes are included with Premium and Ultimate memberships only, or can be purchased individually.

## Location & Service Area

- [Contact and staffed hours](https://infit.org/contact): 6589 Laketowne Place NE, Albertville, MN 55301. Phone/text 763-424-4435. Email info@infit.org. Free on-site parking. The gym is open 24/7/365; staffed hours are listed on this page. The FAQ describes the location as just behind the Outlet Mall.
- [24-hour gym overview](https://infit.org/24hour-gym): Confirms 24/7/365 access, including Christmas and New Year's, with app unlock when staff are not present. Notes convenient access just off I-94.
- [Gym near St. Michael, MN](https://infit.org/gym-st-michael-mn): About 8 minutes from St. Michael.
- [Gym near Otsego, MN](https://infit.org/gym-otsego-mn): About 9 minutes from Otsego.
- [Gym near Rogers, MN](https://infit.org/gym-rogers-mn): About 11 minutes from Rogers.
- [Gym near Monticello, MN](https://infit.org/gym-monticello-mn): About 12 minutes from Monticello.
- [Gym near Hanover, MN](https://infit.org/gym-hanover-mn): About 12 minutes from Hanover.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://infit.org/): Overview of 24/7 access, no-contract memberships starting at $60/mo with sauna included, equipment, classes, personal training, and how to join through the app.
- [Group fitness classes](https://infit.org/classes): In-person and livestream classes at a variety of times. Classes are included with Plus, Premium, and Ultimate, or $15 to drop in. Book in the app or on the class calendar.
- [Personal training](https://infit.org/personal-training): 1-on-1, small group (typically 4–8 people, up to 12), and youth/team training (youth through high school). Personal training is not included in any membership tier; it is a separate add-on. Specialties include weight loss, muscle building, injury recovery, overall health, sports performance, and functional fitness. Contact the gym for pricing.
- [Get the app](https://infit.org/get-the-app): Download, join, book, unlock the door, and manage a membership. Search "inFIT247" in the App Store or Google Play.
